message: A borrow-checking rule has been violated
cause: Ownership system enforces single-writer or multiple-reader semantics on shared state
fix: See specific borrow error codes

cause: A mutable reference overlaps with another active mutable/immutable reference
fix: Restructure borrows to not overlap, or use explicit scope to shorten lifetimes

cause: Value is borrowed while a mutation occurs through another path
fix: Complete all borrows before mutating, or clone the value

cause: A value has been moved and is used afterwards
fix: Clone before the move, or restructure to borrow instead

cause: Cross-actor access without shared/single_writer annotation
fix: Add shared keyword or appropriate synchronization

cause: single_writer state mutated from multiple locations simultaneously
fix: Serialize writes through a single owner

cause: A weak reference was upgraded but target already dropped
fix: Use ? operator or if let when upgrading weak refs

cause: A reference outlives the value it points to
fix: Keep owned value alive longer, or clone

cause: Value sent across actors does not satisfy Send trait
fix: Ensure all fields satisfy Send, or use serialization boundary

cause: Large value being implicitly cloned
fix: Use &value to borrow, or add explicit .clone()
